mintAuthority.summary: crvUSD's immutable ControllerFactory is the token minter and normally pre-mints lending-controller inventory up to DAO-set debt ceilings. The factory's privileged set_debt_ceiling path does not require the recipient to be a registered controller or check collateral: Curve DAO's intermediary can authorize minting to an arbitrary address. User borrowing remains collateral-checked, while the 5-of-9 emergency multisig cannot increase ceilings.

controls.label: crvUSD ControllerFactory
controls.capDescription: The factory cannot raise its own admin-set recipient ceilings. Normal user borrowing through controllers is collateral-checked, but privileged set_debt_ceiling accepts an arbitrary recipient and mints increased inventory without a controller-registration or collateral check. DAO can raise these ceilings; they are not an immutable aggregate supply cap.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095803, crvUSD.minter() returned this factory and factory.admin() returned 0xb7400d2ea0f6dc1d7b153aa430b9e572f28afb79. Verified _set_debt_ceiling calls STABLECOIN.mint(addr, amount) on a ceiling increase without validating addr against registered controllers or requiring collateral. A read-only eth_call from the current DAO Agent through intermediary.execute(factory, set_debt_ceiling(0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD, 1e18)) succeeded at the pinned block; no transaction was sent. Token/factory verified direct-deployment source and zero proxy slots corroborate unchanged native logic, not a limit on governance-authorized issuance.

controls.label: Curve DAO Agent for crvUSD factory
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095803, the factory-admin intermediary's dao() returned this Curve DAO Aragon Agent. The verified intermediary gates execute and factory-ownership transfer to DAO. Its arbitrary-call execution path can invoke factory set_debt_ceiling for an arbitrary recipient, not only a registered collateral controller; a pinned read-only simulation of this full path succeeded. The Agent's own governance execution prerequisites remain separately governed and were not simplified to a single-key signer.

controls.label: crvUSD emergency multisig
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25530324, getThreshold() returned 5, getOwners() returned nine owners, and getModulesPaginated() returned no enabled modules. The intermediary's verified reduce_debt_ceiling() function accepts the emergency address but asserts the new ceiling cannot exceed the current ceiling; arbitrary execute() remains DAO-only.

review.evidence: Ethereum block 26097121 re-confirms crvUSD.minter() as ControllerFactory, factory.admin() as the DAO intermediary, and intermediary.dao() as the Curve DAO Agent. The verified factory set_debt_ceiling path calls _set_debt_ceiling for an arbitrary recipient, and an increase mints inventory without checking registered-controller membership or posted collateral. A read-only eth_call from the DAO Agent through intermediary.execute(factory, set_debt_ceiling(0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD, 1e18)) succeeded at that block; no transaction was sent. There is no same-transaction repayment condition on this durable mint path. Under owner ruling D14, this least-constrained path determines unbounded economic cap semantics and unbounded-or-compromised authority posture; the label does not allege a compromise. Numeric DAO-adjustable ceilings remain described on the controls. The separately anchored emergency multisig remains 5-of-9 and cannot increase ceilings. Native token/factory immutability does not prevent governance-authorized issuance outside normal collateralized borrowing; no prudential supervision or independent attestation is inferred.
